title: she said main ja rahi hoon... barefoot
exact_first_slide_text: she said 'main ja rahi hoon'... barefoot.
concept: Aachu storms toward the door saying she is leaving, but her chappals are still inside. Zuv does not chase or lecture; he quietly turns the chappals toward the door and leaves water near the threshold. She returns 'only for the chappals.' The fight is not magically solved, but the distance gets smaller.
why_selected: It keeps the strongest owned send-behavior engine while adding a fresh visual object. The chappals carry the contradiction: anger wants distance, habit still expects care.
emotional_job: Make someone send it to their partner after a petty fight or tag the dramatic one with affection.
